entries.en: Don't worry. Won't shoot. You're in the system. Go in.
entries.ro: Nu-ți face griji. Nu trag. Ești în sistem. Intră.

entries.en: Hello? Oh, it's you. They call you V, right?
entries.ro: Alo? Ah, tu ești. Te cheamă V, nu?

entries.en: City's smaller than you think. Anyway, come in.
entries.ro: Orașul e mai mic decât crezi. Oricum, intră.
